title: The Ledger Closes
subtitle: It closes every evening. That is not the same as being settled
description: The checkmark at the end of the ledger, and it is gated: the task
carries a `score` condition against `tasked_debt_standing`, and a
submit against an unmet condition is refused rather than ignored.
The objective reads as zero until somebody makes it, which is why
the vault's first account exists: a command reward that runs
`scoreboard objectives add tasked_debt_standing dummy` the moment
it is claimed. A condition against a missing objective is not an
error -- it is a closed gate, and a typo in the name is the same
closed gate with nobody to tell you.
